description: Monitor y Control Multimedia (Arch Linux ↔ Android) — Dashboard multimedia landscape con control remoto para Apple Music PWA en Brave, letras sincronizadas estilo karaoke, y fondo dinámico con mesh gradient extraído de la portada.

userStories.title: Backend scaffolding with WebSocket server and auth
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a Python backend with a WebSocket server and SECRET_TOKEN authentication so the Android app can establish a trusted connection.
acceptanceCriteria: Set up Python venv with requirements.txt (websockets, mypy, ruff)
Create pyproject.toml with mypy and ruff config
Project structure: src/server.py as entry point
WebSocket server listens on localhost, accessible over LAN
SECRET_TOKEN handshake: client must send correct token or connection is rejected
Typecheck passes (mypy)

userStories.title: playerctl integration — monitor Brave PWA playback
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to monitor Apple Music PWA playback via playerctl so the backend knows the current track in real time.
acceptanceCriteria: Identify the Brave PWA instance (brave.instanceXXXX) via playerctl
Set up playerctl follow/monitor mode for the correct instance
Parse raw metadata with regex: extract title and artist (split 'Song — Artist')
Emit playback events (Playing, Paused, Stopped) with parsed metadata
Typecheck passes (mypy)

userStories.title: iTunes Search API enrichment
userStories.description: As a user, I want HD album artwork and accurate track duration, so the UI shows rich metadata beyond what MPRIS provides.
acceptanceCriteria: Query iTunes Search API by track title and artist
Extract art_url (600x600 HD) and duration_ms from API response
Handle API errors gracefully (timeout, no results)
Merge enriched fields into the playback data model
Typecheck passes (mypy)

userStories.title: LRCLIB API enrichment — synchronized lyrics
userStories.description: As a user, I want synchronized lyrics (karaoke-style) fetched via LRCLIB so the app can display timed lyrics.
acceptanceCriteria: Query LRCLIB API by track title and artist
Parse LRC format response (timestamps + lyric lines)
Store both raw LRC string and parsed line array in data model
Handle API errors gracefully (timeout, no lyrics found)
Typecheck passes (mypy)

userStories.title: Unified JSON broadcast and command handling
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the backend to broadcast a unified JSON payload over WebSocket and execute commands received from Android.
acceptanceCriteria: Build unified JSON matching PRD spec: status, title, artist, album, duration_ms, progress_ms, art_url, lyrics
Broadcast updated JSON via WebSocket on every playback change
Receive command JSON from Android: { token, action, value }
Execute actions via playerctl: play, pause, next, previous, seek
Validate token on every command message
Typecheck passes (mypy)

userStories.title: Android project scaffolding with WebSocket client
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a Kotlin/Jetpack Compose Android project with WebSocket connectivity and landscape lock so the app can connect to the backend.
acceptanceCriteria: Gradle project with Jetpack Compose, kotlinx.serialization, OkHttp dependencies
Landscape orientation forced in AndroidManifest.xml
WebSocket client with SECRET_TOKEN handshake on connect
Handle connection states: Connecting, Connected, Disconnected, Error
Typecheck passes (./gradlew compileDebugKotlin)

userStories.title: Data models and ViewModel state management
userStories.description: As a developer, I need typed data models and a ViewModel to manage playback state so the UI can observe and react to backend data.
acceptanceCriteria: Kotlin data class matching backend JSON schema (PlaybackState with all fields)
Sealed class for UI state: Loading, Connected, Playing, Paused, Disconnected, Error
ViewModel connects to WebSocket, parses JSON, exposes StateFlow<UiState>
Typecheck passes (./gradlew compileDebugKotlin)

userStories.title: Dynamic mesh gradient background via Palette API
userStories.description: As a user, I want a dynamic animated background that extracts colors from the album art, creating an immersive visual experience.
acceptanceCriteria: Load album art image from art_url using Coil
Extract dominant/vibrant colors via Android Palette API
Draw animated mesh gradient on Canvas with blurred moving spheres/ellipses
Animation runs continuously and smoothly (Apple Music-style background)
Typecheck passes (./gradlew compileDebugKotlin)
Verify on Android emulator

userStories.title: Player Mode UI — 50/50 layout with controls
userStories.description: As a user, I want the default Player Mode with album art, metadata, progress bar, and playback controls in a split-screen layout.
acceptanceCriteria: 50/50 horizontal split: left panel (album art + metadata), right panel (progress + controls)
Left panel: album art displayed large, title (bold), album name, artist name centered below
Right panel: functional SeekBar/progress bar showing progress_ms / duration_ms
Right panel controls: Previous, Play/Pause toggle, Next — large touch-friendly buttons
Lyrics toggle button to switch to Lyrics Mode
UI updates reactively from ViewModel StateFlow
Typecheck passes (./gradlew compileDebugKotlin)
Verify on Android emulator

userStories.title: Lyrics Mode UI — expanded lyrics display
userStories.description: As a user, I want to switch to Lyrics Mode where the lyrics take over most of the screen and the player controls are minimized.
acceptanceCriteria: Compressed left panel: smaller album art, only title + artist (no album), controls and progress bar below
Expanded right panel: full-width scrollable lyrics area
Toggle button switches between Player Mode and Lyrics Mode
Layout adapts based on lyrics availability (show placeholder if no lyrics)
Typecheck passes (./gradlew compileDebugKotlin)
Verify on Android emulator

userStories.title: Karaoke-style synchronized lyrics highlighting
userStories.description: As a user, I want lyrics to auto-scroll and highlight the current verse as the song plays, creating a karaoke experience.
acceptanceCriteria: Parse LRC timestamps from the lyrics field into a list of (time_ms, text) pairs
Auto-scroll the lyrics list as progress_ms advances
Highlight the current verse with a distinct style (brighter color, larger font)
Smooth scrolling animation between verses
Typecheck passes (./gradlew compileDebugKotlin)
Verify on Android emulator

userStories.title: Mode transitions, animations, and reconnection handling
userStories.description: As a user, I want smooth animated transitions between modes and reliable reconnection when the device wakes from sleep.
acceptanceCriteria: Animated crossfade/slide transition between Player Mode and Lyrics Mode
Animated entry for album art and text (fade-in on track change)
WebSocket reconnection on screen wake (detect via BroadcastReceiver or lifecycle)
Retry handshake with exponential backoff on disconnect
Typecheck passes (./gradlew compileDebugKotlin)
Verify on Android emulator
